description:
Reads the address, confirmation, receipt and release of your charge, free of charge.
Reuse X-Cobranca and respect Retry-After. The lookup does not write or make a blockchain RPC. When it is gerando, use GET /geracao for phases/pages; pronto releases the reading links. In revisao, keep the ID and the transactions for support, without paying again.

cobranca_token.description: 32 random bytes in 64 lowercase hex characters. Generate and keep it before the POST; reuse it in the GET and in retries. Secret for access to your charge.
